answer: Shared Nectar Diversity Rule: each agent identity must forage from at least three distinct resource gardens per epoch, and its collected nectar profile is hashed into a public orchard ledger. Duplicate identities controlled by one operator converge on the same three gardens, so their profiles cluster; any cluster above a set density threshold triggers cross-examination of provenance records, and the entire plume of linked accounts is frozen. An attacker must provision genuinely independent garden access per identity, multiplying infrastructure cost linearly with each fake account.
